Focus on in-game HUD hierarchy, health/ammo/wave/score readability, start/game-over presentation, spacing, typography, contrast, subtle depth, and keeping the center of the 3D action unobstructed. Preserve gameplay and existing art direction. Mobile landscape and safe areas are first-class. Avoid large panels, generic app chrome, or clutter. Prefer CSS/DOM presentation changes and minimal JS only when necessary. Return a coherent unified diff within the allowlisted scope and exact tests to run. Do not claim tests were run.
